handoff: Changes requested, 3 blocking: README.md:77 and docs/development.md:26 still describe old-config and migrate behaviour (AC11); needs_removed refusal still says run norn upgrade, which no longer strips needs.

findings.title: README still says norn upgrade fixes an older norn's repo and old config keys
findings.detail:
README.md:77 reads: "A repository set up by an older norn, or a config written for one, refuses every command and names `norn upgrade` (and each old key with its replacement): run it once in the main checkout, with `norn watch` stopped, and commit what it prints." After this slice, a config with an old key fails with `do_instead: fix <file>` (output.ts configError) and upgrade exits 6 on it without renaming anything. A repo from before 0.30 is refused with the 0.30.x path. AC11 says: "nothing mentions old config keys … the 0.30 starting point is stated". User story 23 says the same of the README.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Rewrite the sentence: an old config key is named with its replacement, to be fixed in that file. A repo with no or a pre-0.30 `norn_version` takes the 0.30.x path (or link the recipe). Leave the layout guard's wording to slice 05 if it must stay until then.

findings.title: docs/development.md lists the deleted old-layout.ts and `migrate`'s moves
findings.detail:
The store row of the layout table ends "layout.ts + old-layout.ts (old/new/both, migrate's moves)". This slice deletes packages/store/src/old-layout.ts and `norn migrate`. AC11: "nothing mentions … `norn migrate`" in `docs/`.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Drop `old-layout.ts` and "migrate's moves" from that row. Keep layout.ts as long as it exists (slice 05 removes it).

findings.title: needs_removed refusal still says run `norn upgrade`, which no longer removes `needs`
findings.detail:
Bug this change introduces: the advice now leads nowhere. agent-unit.ts:130 refuses with `do_instead: cmd.upgrade()`, and the message comes from packages/schema/src/criteria.ts:26 needsRemovedMessage: "`needs` was removed; run `norn upgrade`". The inbox shows the same message (packages/core/src/inbox/items.ts:23). This slice removes migrateConfig's `needs` strip (D10). The test upgrade.test.ts › "with a valid config the upgrade succeeds and the slice, spec and .gitattributes stay unchanged" shows that upgrade leaves a slice with `needs` exactly as it was. A person who follows the hint gets a successful upgrade (or "already on norn X: nothing to upgrade") and the same refusal. D11 removed the matching `; run \`norn upgrade\`` suffix from the config messages for the same reason. The handoff flags this under Notes and left it unfixed.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Point the message and do_instead at the fix itself, e.g. "delete `needs` from the criteria in <file>", the way D11 handled config keys. Assert it in the agent-unit or brief test that covers needs_removed.
